scope: Isolated candidate checks, generic fixtures and literal frozen-input parser contracts; not full live ingestion or clinical validation
assessment_basis: Workflow exposure is inferred from the observed trigger and pinned source, not measured production frequency. Real JASEN input, local account practices and feature usage have not been supplied. Severity remains the development catalog's assessment. Exact patch sizes are measured against each candidate's stated base; prerequisite changes are additional.
selection_rule: Review severity, the chance of encountering the stated trigger in this installation, and the size of the required change together. A small patch is not by itself proof of low risk. 'Early review' suggests review order, not authorization to merge.

verification.scope: Isolated candidate checks, generic fixtures and literal frozen-input parser contracts; not full live ingestion or clinical validation

merge_resolutions: When combined with CSV-EMPTY-CELL-500, union the pydantic imports (BeforeValidator and field_validator).
When combined with METADATA-TABLE-EMPTY, union the pydantic imports (BeforeValidator and field_validator).
When combined with VARIANT-HIDE-DISMISSED-500, retain both the decision merge and the null-safe row lookup.
When combined with TB-NO-AMR-500, retain both the decision merge and the null-safe row lookup.

candidates.head: e07c608476803971b48e980fe1ffb318a2f2db0a
candidates.title: Require write permission for record deletion
candidates.normal_workflow: An ordinary account using the delete API is affected every time. The ordinary UI hides deletion, so accidental normal UI use is less likely.
candidates.minimal_fix: Use the existing write permission on both deletion routes.
candidates.caveat: Destructive permission boundary; verify ordinary denial and administrator access before release.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: 5b7e90594dde4b4b514eef8d45db46162da499ea
candidates.title: Apply route-specific role scopes to generic create and read
candidates.normal_workflow: A dedicated uploader creates a generic record, or an ordinary user uses the legacy list endpoint. The frontend's summary list takes another path.
candidates.minimal_fix: Remove the unrelated shared scope and retain explicit per-route scopes.
candidates.caveat: This is the prerequisite for the one-line upload boundary fix.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: dd5c2481be225712b0b4ae0565d7b701b4c4686e
candidates.title: Require write permission for analysis uploads
candidates.normal_workflow: Every dedicated-uploader submission is denied; ordinary-account submissions are admitted. Exposure depends on which role the ingestion client uses.
candidates.minimal_fix: Change the upload route to the existing write scope, after repairing shared role checks.
candidates.caveat: Requires ACCOUNT-ROLE-PERMISSIONS. Authorization was tested with the downstream service stubbed.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: ce4fa9e1779d0b3f08e3630520565ca3d01cd57e
candidates.title: Reject new private-marked records while sample ACLs are unfinished
candidates.policy_condition: Public-only creation; does not add ACLs or migrate existing private-marked records
candidates.normal_workflow: Public-default workflows are unaffected. Any private-marked record remains readable across accounts if this unfinished privacy feature is relied on.
candidates.minimal_fix: The candidate rejects new private-marked records, selecting a public-only creation contract.
candidates.caveat: Partial containment only: existing private-marked records remain exposed. A private-data deployment needs ACL enforcement or a separate migration/access decision; this branch alone does not close P0.
candidates.resolution: Conditional containment; privacy P0 remains open for existing private data

candidates.head: 5861b369bc71470a980ae4aed3911937df109fb7
candidates.title: Limit group deletion to the target membership edges
candidates.normal_workflow: Deleting a populated group removes other memberships when records belong to multiple groups. Overlapping cohorts make this a realistic administrative trigger.
candidates.minimal_fix: Match the target group after unwinding membership arrays.
candidates.caveat: A one-stage query fix prevents unrelated membership deletion.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: 0e782307e2551a6c3afad00b5595bb6417e9624f
candidates.title: Preserve individual memberships when applying common groups
candidates.normal_workflow: Applying an unchanged common group selection erases individual memberships when the selected records have different groups.
candidates.minimal_fix: Remove only originally common groups and capture the selection used by Apply.
candidates.caveat: No component redesign or partial-batch recovery is included.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: e767620b6d62b0dcbb9530147461280e22a7fbef
candidates.title: Append typed metadata alongside existing stored fields
candidates.normal_workflow: Appending to a record with existing metadata reaches the broken dictionary/object mix. A first append to an empty record may succeed.
candidates.minimal_fix: Keep stored records as dictionaries and serialize only new typed fields.
candidates.caveat: Concurrent append safety is a separate dependent candidate.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: d7ee2464e82811107129ca462acd6cb6189d4603
candidates.title: Append metadata atomically without overwriting concurrent fields
candidates.normal_workflow: Two users or automated clients append fields to the same record before either save completes. Less likely in a single-editor manual workflow.
candidates.minimal_fix: Append atomically with a field-name condition and distinguish duplicate conflicts.
candidates.caveat: Requires METADATA-ADD-500. Independent fields and competing duplicate fields were checked under forced overlap.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: 34cbe08fed81255fd3d8d3d45b9763aabe5af934
candidates.title: Allocate distinct comment IDs under concurrent append
candidates.normal_workflow: Comments submitted to one record at the same time can share an ID. Ordinary sequential comments do not trigger the collision.
candidates.minimal_fix: Condition the append on ID availability and retry an actual collision.
candidates.caveat: Existing duplicate IDs are not renumbered by this fix.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: e049aec434621b10c094ff6888dda27abf8dec3f
candidates.title: Send only changed fields from the group editor
candidates.normal_workflow: One user leaves a group editor open while another changes a different field. Saving the older form overwrites the unrelated change.
candidates.minimal_fix: Send only changed core fields and changed column selection.
candidates.caveat: Same-field last-writer behavior and pending-save controls remain separate P2 issues.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: 13a4b49e3f6b50e8c717af6db068eb29d6a6273b
candidates.title: Group interleaved metadata categories without dropping fields
candidates.normal_workflow: Fields from a previously used category are appended after another category. Stored order then interleaves categories.
candidates.minimal_fix: Sort by category before grouping the display fields.
candidates.caveat: Only display grouping changes; stored field order and values remain untouched.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: fa643f1d987e4b90a25f3bcd530581c19651e44e
candidates.title: Render accepted metadata table shapes consistently
candidates.normal_workflow: An accepted metadata table is opened in the summary or standalone table view. Frequency depends on whether table metadata is used locally.
candidates.minimal_fix: Normalize the accepted read shapes and render their headings and rows.
candidates.caveat: Three files cover the model/read boundary and template; this is larger than the single-line display fixes.
candidates.merge_note: When combined with CSV-EMPTY-CELL-500, union the pydantic imports (BeforeValidator and field_validator).

candidates.head: 9811fa547b554c5b5dee2e6e742bca8d2b0deb2f
candidates.title: Normalize missing numeric CSV cells to empty text
candidates.normal_workflow: A CSV has a blank cell in a column inferred as numeric. Such blanks are ordinary inventory/metadata input, if CSV tables are used.
candidates.minimal_fix: Normalize missing numeric cells to empty text in the stored table model.
candidates.caveat: The patch handles the reported missing-cell case; unrelated malformed numeric input is excluded.
candidates.merge_note: When combined with METADATA-TABLE-EMPTY, union the pydantic imports (BeforeValidator and field_validator).

candidates.head: aa554c2ad2cbb0adf9eccf8487b237bdc9a583e0
candidates.title: Submit a confirmation once and render refreshed state
candidates.normal_workflow: One Confirm action invokes the same save twice. The first save can persist before the second call reports a conflict.
candidates.minimal_fix: Remove the duplicate service call and reload state after the save.
candidates.caveat: Only generic stubbed service calls and refreshed rendering were tested; no live decision was written.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: 859f603e8db62593a71518b29a35e1bf11917a2c

candidates.normal_workflow: Show selected is active and the last selected row is cleared. The stale display also contaminates the subsequent CSV export.
candidates.minimal_fix: Redraw the shared table after selection changes.
candidates.caveat: The shared handler also covers ordinary accounts without administrator group controls.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: 6d08d7abd5256440ad9f0c74b25e77b7c0ac5b5a

candidates.normal_workflow: The header checkbox is clicked in the stored-row table, including after a table filter. Individual row clicks avoid the extra target.

candidates.caveat: Selection payloads were checked without submitting any action.

candidates.head: 16fb3d32d5b9694365c3880eb2cb63b05eb08e5e
candidates.title: Intersect numeric row-filter predicates
candidates.normal_workflow: Both numeric predicates are enabled and a row passes only the second. Using one predicate does not expose the overwritten result.
candidates.minimal_fix: Combine each depth predicate with the existing accumulated filter result.
candidates.caveat: Only Boolean filter composition changes.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.head: 20bbb27b2f85c82a25557aa2527f65f009c02019
candidates.title: Read the stored rejection decision when filtering rows
candidates.normal_workflow: The option is enabled for stored rows using the current decision schema. The obsolete field lookup then fails.
candidates.minimal_fix: Merge saved decisions before filtering and read the existing rejection decision.
candidates.caveat: Read-only filtering is checked; stored decisions are not changed.
candidates.merge_note: When combined with TB-NO-AMR-500, retain both the decision merge and the null-safe row lookup.

candidates.head: 77b75326f97936382633c001a9ee7a562b48a824
candidates.title: Use plain QC status values for SearchBuilder filtering
candidates.normal_workflow: SearchBuilder filters QC exactly while that column is excluded from global search. The normal overview column configuration has this combination.
candidates.minimal_fix: Provide the plain status search value and the SearchBuilder orthogonal mapping.
candidates.caveat: Real DataTables checks cover exact filtering, combined conditions, clearing and export data.
candidates.resolution: Targeted fix; stated validation limits apply

candidates.normal_workflow: More than 100 records are selected for group management. Smaller selections do not hit the membership query limit.
candidates.minimal_fix: Batch membership reads within the API limit while retaining common-group calculation.
candidates.caveat: A 125-record generic selection was checked; this does not resolve partial write batches.

candidates.title: Handle typed SDK not-found during local user creation
candidates.normal_workflow: An administrator submits a new local account. This is infrequent administration, and may be uncommon if external authentication supplies all users.
candidates.minimal_fix: Catch the SDK's typed not-found exception during the existence check.
candidates.caveat: A small deterministic fix for the local-account administration path.

candidates.head: 619cab28e4bf8f8706a391804b017442090106aa
